text.paragraph: Referral to Texas Health Presbyterian Hospital Denton for planned birth-hospital care, registration, delivery planning, and continuity of prenatal information. This is a birth-hospital planning referral; it does not transfer ongoing prenatal care away from Simone Heps at Health Services of North Texas. The accompanying 32-week Antepartum Summary provides the detailed longitudinal record. Registration is planned for August 25 and has not yet occurred in this snapshot.
